title: CMB polarisation spectrum row
description: One binned (TE/EE) or unbinned (low-ell BB) multipole of the CMB polarisation power spectra from Planck 2018 V. Single row_type 'multipole_bin'; each row records the bin center ell, the bin half-width (zero for unbinned low-ell BB), the power D_ell = ell(ell+1) C_ell / (2 pi) in muK^2, the 1-sigma error on D_ell, the spectrum kind (TE, EE, or BB), and a feature label identifying the row's role in the polarisation acoustic-peak structure. The schema mirrors cmb_power_spectrum.row.v1 for TT but restricts spectrum_kind to {TE, EE, BB}.

ell_bin_label.description: Stable identifier for this binned multipole (e.g. 'TE_ell0285_first_peak' or 'EE_ell0405_first_peak').

row_type.description: Single value in this catalogue (matching cmb_power_spectrum.row.v1).

ell_center.description: Central (effective) multipole of the bin. For unbinned low-ell BB rows this is the integer ell. For binned TE/EE this is the PR3 R3.02 effective ell quoted in the file (e.g. 285.025248 for the 5th bin).

ell_half_width.description: Half-width of the multipole bin. Zero for unbinned low-ell BB. For binned TE/EE this is computed from adjacent-bin-center midpoints (PR3 uses approximately delta-ell = 30 binning above ell = 30).

D_ell_muK2.description: Binned power D_ell = ell(ell+1) C_ell / (2 pi) in units of muK^2. For TE this can be positive or negative (TE alternates sign across the acoustic peaks); for EE this is positive but typically much smaller than TT (peak ~ 40 muK^2 at ell ~ 400 vs TT peak ~ 5400 muK^2 at ell ~ 220); for BB at Planck sensitivity these are noise-dominated values fluctuating around zero with ~0.01 muK^2 amplitude.

D_ell_error_muK2.description: 1-sigma Gaussian error on D_ell in muK^2. For PR3 binned TE/EE this is the symmetric error from the file (-dD_ell = +dD_ell). For unbinned low-ell BB this is the Commander-likelihood error.

spectrum_kind.description: Which polarisation spectrum this bin belongs to: TE = temperature-E-polarization cross, EE = E-mode autocorrelation, BB = B-mode (Planck has only upper limits at low ell). TT is hosted in the sister cmb_power_spectrum catalogue.

feature.description: Qualitative label identifying the row's role in the polarisation peak structure. TE alternates sign with acoustic phase (positive between TT peak and trough; negative at TT peaks and EE peaks). 'te_zero_crossing' marks ell where TE crosses zero (around ell ~ 90, 280, 420, 565, 660). 'ee_reionization_bump' marks the low-ell EE reionization signal at ell < 30.

lcdm_bestfit_D_ell_muK2.description: Optional LambdaCDM best-fit D_ell at the bin center, in muK^2 (the BestFit column of the PR3 files). Provided as a reference value for comparison; not used in the likelihood directly.

precision_flag.description: Per-row precision flag. PR3 polarisation rows are 'high' (values from PLA tables verbatim).

source_doi.description: DOI of the cited Planck reference. Default 10.1051/0004-6361/201936386 (Planck 2018 V).

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 partial date for the cited source.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was added to the AMSC catalogue.

source_version.description: Optional Planck release version, e.g. 'PR3/R3.02' (TE/EE) or 'PR3/R3.01' (BB).
